verdict.rationale: Jira's Cloud platform REST API is explicitly versioned, with v2 and v3 documented and v3 marked latest. Atlassian also publishes a formal REST API policy: deprecated cloud APIs stay available in their original form for at least 6 months, deprecated endpoints return RFC 9745 headers, and a dedicated section covers API versioning. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that deprecations actually follow the published 6-month window and header signalling.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy

citations.quote: This documentation is for version 3 of the Jira Cloud platform REST API, which is the latest version.
a deprecated REST API in the cloud environment must remain available in its original form "for at least 6 months"
